Name: Wall Art - Animals
Author: Acc9000
Description:
Every animal has several pictures in different formats and views. 

[u]Configs:[/u]

[color=#00ff00]Backgrounds[/color]: Tutti frutti (mix of colours with subtle patterns), Plain (various colours), Off white, Black.
Note that butterflies are always on off white or black backgrounds.

[color=#ff7700]Frames[/color]: Birch, Black, Dark wood, Gold, Gold desaturated, Green, Joja, Junimo, Light walnut, Mahogany, Oak, Pink, Silver, Walnut, White

[color=#ffff00]Animals[/color]: Vanilla, Desaturated

There are a few extra animals whose backgrounds don't change.
If you find any irregularities, they are intentional.


All the pictures can be found in the catalogue bought at Robin.

This is probably my largest mod so far, with lots of scope creeping. It all came from the idea that someone wished a picture of the possum. Hope you enjoy, then! :D
